# Test fixtures

`ode-to-joy-8s.wav`: 8 s, 16 kHz mono. Beethoven's *Ode to Joy* (public domain) with a simple left-hand
pattern, rendered with the [Salamander Grand Piano](https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3) samples
by Alexander Holm (CC BY 3.0) via Tone.js. `ode-to-joy-8s.notes.json` holds the exact notes that were rendered.
Regenerate with `scripts/render-fixture.cjs`.
